Xanadu Quantum Technologies Limited (XNDU) Breakthrough Reduces the Cost of Quantum Applications

On May 21, 2026, Xanadu Quantum Technologies Limited (NASDAQ:XNDU) said it achieved an algorithmic breakthrough in Quantum Read-Only Memory by cutting expensive quantum operations roughly in half. It also addresses a key hardware bottleneck.
